s00886.summary: Barber Jedediah lathers gunman Colton in a cliffside shop while a widow sews.
Jedediah draws the razor along Colton's jaw and reveals he knows he killed his son.
After a long moment he lifts the razor, saying the sheriff is on his way.

s02483.summary: Rosalba fits a wedding dress on daughter Carmelina and scolds her.
Isotta insists she is not marrying; Rosalba admits she sewed the dress anyway.
Carmelina tears the hem, and Rosalba silently studies it in the window light.

s02313.summary: Brodie and Dubois play chess in the trench as shells fall.
Brodie takes Dubois's bishop; Dubois sets a photograph of his sister on the board.
Brodie tips over his king and lays it beside the photograph.

s00851.summary: A pastry chef, planner, bellhop, and grandmother are stuck in an elevator with a wedding cake.
The elevator shudders; Bart and Yolanda collide while Fionnuala keeps knitting.
Chen's radio fails and the emergency phone is out of order.
The car drops and the trio dive to save the cake in a heap.

s01464.summary: Tamsin and Udo wade through a drowned dragon cathedral toward the Ember.
The Warden's voice asks what they will offer, and Tamsin draws her sword.
Tamsin offers her true name in trade for the Ember despite Udo's protest.
Tamsin whispers her name and the Ember settles unburning in her palm.
The Warden laughs, the water rises, and they run as the nave collapses.
The doors slam behind them and Tamsin, in the dark, asks what her name was.

s01523.summary: Luddy arrives at the drained pool and probes sweating Caz about missing Tomas.
A shadow crosses the skylight and Luddy senses Caz betrayed her.
Tomas arrives upstairs; Luddy shoots out the work light and darkness falls.
Caz admits the briefcase was always empty while Tomas lights a lighter, smiling.

s01754.summary: Lookout Noelle answers dispatcher Barrett's radio check, and he reassures her.
Noelle asks if he was ever scared; Barrett says every summer for twenty-two years.
She spots a gray column on the west ridge and takes a bearing.
Barrett praises her first call and keeps her company during the wait.
The smoke was a cloud; Noelle laughs and cries, embarrassed, as Barrett reassures her.
Noelle calls the false alarm and offers a spoonful of peanut butter to the room.

s02074.summary: At a family reunion in a roller rink, grandchildren hide and Nneka watches.
Nneka taps the bench; Juniper joins her and says her father didn't mean it about selling the house.
Nneka coaxes Basil over, examines the wheel, and tells him to keep it.
Rafael approaches his mother, laughs at her quip, and sits.

s01906_0.summary: A shuttered desert roadhouse sits abandoned as wind moves tumbleweeds and a shutter taps.

s01119_0.summary: Madame Clementine pins fabric by lamplight until the shop bell rings and she answers.

s02059.summary: Inspector Leopold gathers suspects around a body and notes Toby's shoes.
Toby says his shoes were wet from the deck; Imogen recalls seeing a one-oared boat.
Clementine produces a wet shoe from the deck that Bruno claims is his.
Catherine calmly takes up the stove poker and refuses to put it down.

s00097.summary: In a bus-turned-bridal shop, Imani and Philomena argue over a too-big gown.
Aunt Cordelia on the phone sets Philomena crying; Gwendolyn wipes her cheek.
The driver grumbles and Lucien jokes that Philomena looks like a lighthouse.
The bus lurches into motion and rolls into the street with the wedding party aboard.

s01946.summary: Four passengers cross a dark swamp on Morvan's barge, wary and silent.
The Drowned King rises from the water and claims the child as payment.
Briar clings to Hesper as Sable shoots and pale hands grip the barge.

s01008.summary: Gaston finds a man's watch baked into a cheese rind, and Heloise says the owner is missing.
Ignatius flinches, Josephine laughs nervously, and Heloise orders everyone to stay put.
Gaston questions Ignatius, and Heloise's light finds a boot in the oldest wheel.

s00667.summary: Three skaters begin the final jam before a roaring crowd.
Bron charges, Mo and Razor block, and all three crash in a heap.
Mo and Razor help injured Bron up; she laughs and they celebrate.

s00649.summary: Four hikers freeze on a swaying rope bridge as Jojo tells them to keep to the center.
A plank breaks; Jojo leaps the gap and Darius loses his camera case.
Solveig orders a quick single-file crossing and they cross the swaying gap.
Safe on rock, they are silent and Emeka comforts weeping Darius.

s01475_1.summary: Three exhausted soldiers shelter in a sugar mill and plan the river bridge.
The Sergeant hands the Medic a rag and learns his name is Ibrahim.
The Captain asks his age and shares her saved tin of peaches.
The Sergeant takes first watch and tells sleepy Ibrahim the bridge can wait.

s01867.summary: Headmistress Eugenia presides over tea, correcting Arabella's posture and delaying the music.
Arabella and Clara trade whispered insults until Eugenia quells them.
The clock strikes four and Martha sees a telegram boy leave a telegram.
Eugenia hands Arabella the telegram; she reads that her father is coming.

s00755.summary: Connie and Elmer play a quiet bocce match with Viola refereeing.
Connie scores four to two while Elmer stalls with ceremony.
Elmer's cane trembles, he touches a hidden photograph, and deflects Connie's concern.
Viola measures and calls the game; Elmer leaves without thanks.

s02371.summary: Wren and Teo wait in a nearly empty laundromat as a stranger enters.
The stranger half-opens his duffel and Wren recognizes him as Baz.
Baz climbs to machine four and reaches behind the drum while Teo feeds another quarter.

s01225.summary: Gustavo fumbles signals while his mother Fátima interrupts instructor Gretchen.
He clips a cone and Gretchen fails him, snapping her clipboard so he stalls.
Fátima sweetly offers to drive, and both stare at her.

s01636.summary: Tied six-six in the final end, Astrid calls for a draw to the button.
Linnea's stone is swept hard but stops a hair short.
The rival's last stone hits the button and the official calls for measurement.
Oddmund measures and finds Nygaard's stone ahead by a tenth; Astrid demands another measure.
The win is confirmed, the team erupts, and Astrid tells Linnea her shot was enough.

s01327.summary: Thieves Nadia and Spoon sit in a funicular car halted mid-slope.
A floodlight sweeps the cable and they drop to the floor, then the car lurches.
They whisper about cowardly Eddie as a relay counts down two minutes.
The car resumes, tension breaks, and they joke about hearts and the case.
Nadia coaches Spoon into a pompous Doctor Stahl persona and they step out.

s00520.summary: Osei inspects cheese wheels at night while eager new hire Priya trails him.
Faint clicks echo in the cave; Osei says pipes and sends Priya for coffee.
Alone, Osei finds a hidden duffel of cash and learns the new girl was never hired.
Dmitri steps out and Priya returns with a pistol demanding the bag.
Dmitri turns off the radio, mocks Osei's wife, and Priya cocks the pistol.

s02515.summary: Firefighters wait for chili while Captain Loretta makes probie Faye mop again.
The scanner announces a structure fire and the crew rushes out.
Faye returns to the empty kitchen, sets down the mop, and whispers a wish.
